claim: In Gravesend's underpass a repetitive corridor is bays each of one sector lit by one fitting: each bay is as dark as its own tube and a dead tube makes a dark bay, with no light pools cut, so the corridor costs no more walls than an unlit one.
use: Split a long passage at its beams into bay sectors and give each a lamp group (light_stage.LampGroup).
